{{Top|leg}}
A '''location beacon'''<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> or '''location transceiver'''<ref name="TPO">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters|story=Two for the Price of One}}</ref> was a piece of emergency equipment utilized to alert rescue teams to the location of individuals in distress. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used them aboard [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based installations such as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DSTC" /> [[Miner/Legends|Miners]] also carried them installed into their [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]].<ref name="TPO" />
